article.headline: Garcia scores 16 as East Texas A&M downs Northwestern State 74-68
article.description: — Damian Garcia scored 16 points as East Texas A&M beat Northwestern State 74-68 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Garcia scores 16 as East Texas A&M downs Northwestern State 74-68

categories.description: East Texas A&M Lions @ Northwestern State Demons

event.description: East Texas A&M Lions @ Northwestern State Demons

keywords: East Texas A&M Lions @ Northwestern State Demons
article.story: NATCHITOCHES, La. -- — Damian Garcia scored 16 points as East Texas A&M beat Northwestern State 74-68 on Wednesday. Garcia also contributed six rebounds and five assists for the Lions (9-15, 4-10 Southland Conference). Gianni Hunt scored 16 points and added five rebounds and six assists. Vinny Sigona finished 5 of 9 from 3-point range for 16 points. Micah Thomas led the Demons (6-17, 4-10) in scoring, finishing with 23 points and two steals. Willie Williams added 10 points and eight rebounds for Northwestern State. The Demons have now lost six straight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
